chapter: Kid Thomas band and dance work
title: Advertising trucks and carnival balls with Kid Thomas
summary: Playing from trucks to advertise dances, floats, and the auditorium carnival balls; Thomas could fill the hall with four pieces.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: That's nuts. Did you ever play any advertisements on the trucks?

Uh, advertisements? Yeah. Yeah, we used to play around in trucks. Uh-huh. From corner to corner like that. In Algiers? Yeah. They used to play all around in Algiers like that. You see, a long time ago, when they'd give a dance, you'd have to advertise that dance, go all around corner to corner in the truck playing, you know? Well, we used to go around like that. Play on carnival day like that, we'd be on a float or something with a car like that, playing on some of them floats. Did you ever play for any politicians? Well, no, we played, all the play we played, me and Thomas and them played several times over at, uh, over at, uh, auditorium during the carnival season. I played a couple of times over there with Thomas at the auditorium during the carnival season with them carnival balls.
Yeah. That's something that, that must have been something, huh? Oh, yeah.

Did he have to bring a big band or used to bring a band? Well, he brought about, didn't bring no more than these seven piece bands. Yeah, that's all. But Thomas was a boy, Thomas could make music with four pieces. Yeah. If he had four bands, he'd come on and play. But that's a big auditorium. Yeah, that's a big auditorium, I hope I tell you that. He could fill the whole thing up with a- Well, Thomas was loud on the trumpet too, you know, Thomas, for a little man, Thomas blows loud on the horn for a small man like him. He's got good wind, he's got a good lip. Of course that's what it takes, a good lip on the trumpet. If you ain't got a good lip on the trumpet, you just can't blow the trumpet. See? You take Peter, the old boy, now, he's a, I don't care what kind of music you bring him, he could read that music, but he couldn't execute good, because he didn't have that lip. Yeah. Play a soft horn like, but he couldn't play, he couldn't play out loud, because he had that lip.
